document.abstract: Digital techniques are becoming prevalent in audio and video production. Telephone techniques are similarly evolving. Audio and video professionals are faced with learning new communications terms and techniques. This paper is a beginner's guide to digital telephone terminology with examples drawn from LucasArts' use of this type of terrestrial telecommunications.
